newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: D.Telecom Philippine unit subscribers up.
newsitem.headline: D.Telecom Philippine unit subscribers up.

text.p: Isla Communications Co Inc (Islacom), a Philippine affiliate of Deutsche Telecom, said on Wednesday that the company's cellular phone subscriber base rose by 57 percent to 47,000 from 1995's 30,000 subscribers.

Cesar Campos, Islacom president, told reporters that the company is making efforts to further increase its customer base with a 260 million peso project that will install 200 more cell sites within 18 months. At present, the company has 80 cell sites.
Islacom is one of five cellular mobile phone operators in the Philippines.
Deutsche has a 35 percent stake in Islacom. Other shareholders of the company are Shinawatra Computer & Communications Plc and local unlisted company Asia Communications Inc.
